text:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up: Tenant Gamma goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. They chose lightweight onboarding; goal = stable perf + early renewal signals.

Marco (CS): Nice. What's the prefill / warmup we should recommend for a low-touch plan?

Aisha (CS): Proposal: 1) Prefill top 3 flows into shared prefix cache, 2) 15-min ramp at 0.5-2 rps, 3) Enable streaming only for demo_path, 4) KV cache TTL = 6h for first 72h to iterate quickly.

Aisha (CS): Example prefill payload:
```
POST /v1/prefill
{
  "tenant_id": "gamma",
  "flows": ["signup_flow","search_hint","summary_flow"],
  "rate_per_flow": 1,
  "stagger_seconds": 10
}
```

Rory (SRE): Ops notes: stagger tenants by 10s, max 3 concurrent warmups, autoscale headroom +30% first 6h. If any node >85% GPU util pause warmup and notify oncall.

oncall-bot: warmup-check scheduled at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

Jules (PM): Renewal-risk signals to capture first 72h: errors >5% by route, median latency >800ms on primary flows, >20% dropped streaming sessions -> tag as "early_risk" and escalate.

Marco (CS): I'll draft a customer 1-pager: prefill JSON, cost estimate, how to pause warmup, and a smoke-test checklist.

Aisha (CS): Draft checklist:
- Run prefill for top 3 flows
- Smoke: 5 streaming + 5 non-streaming queries
- Confirm median latency <1s and error rate <2%
- Share short feedback survey link

Marco (CS): Feedback plan: in-app 3-question survey + week-1 1:1 for high-touch customers. Low-touch gets survey only unless early_risk flagged.

Rory (SRE): Tag traces with tenant_id, prefill_run_id, warmup_stage for easy querying. I'll add dashboard panels and alerts.

Aisha (CS): Post-launch cadence: Day0 warmup+smoke, Day1 CS+SRE health sync, Day3 retention-signal check, Day7 baseline report + feedback capture.

Jules (PM): I'll add thresholds to AM handbook. Marco, can you share the 1-pager by EOD?

Marco (CS): Yep, will post the draft here by 17:00.

Aisha (CS): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Rory, anything else?

Rory (SRE): LGTM, hooking up alerts now.
